title: Jaat director Gopichand confirms his next film with Balakrishna – More details inside
summary: Tollywood director Gopichand Malineni, riding the success of Jaat, has confirmed a sequel (Jaat 2) and revealed he will reunite with Nandamuri Balakrishna for a new film. The script for the Balakrishna project is in development and will be launched on the actor's birthday, June 10, 2025. Gopichand's schedule is full through 2026.
content:
Tollywood director Gopichand Malineni, who recently ventured into Bollywood with Jaat starring Sunny Deol, is currently celebrating the movie’s success. With Jaat still performing well in theatres across India, the director has confirmed that a sequel, Jaat 2, is officially in the works.

In an exclusive interview with Bollywood Hungama, Gopichand revealed that his next film will reunite him with Nandamuri Balakrishna after their successful collaboration on Veera Simha Reddy. He mentioned that the script for this new project is currently under development and that the film will be officially launched on NBK’s birthday, June 10, 2025.

Fans of Balakrishna are eagerly awaiting the details of this upcoming film, particularly the genre and the powerful role Balayya is expected to play.

Meanwhile, Gopichand confirmed that the script work for Jaat 2 is already underway. The director and his team are taking audience feedback into account as they plan the sequel, aiming for an even bigger impact than the first film.

With two major projects in the works, one in Tollywood and another in Bollywood, Gopichand Malineni’s schedule is packed until the end of 2026. Fans can expect exciting updates on his ventures with Balakrishna and Jaat 2 soon.

He mentioned that the script for this new project is currently under development and that the film will be officially launched on NBK’s birthday, June 10, 2025.

## Fan Expectations

Fans of Balakrishna are eagerly awaiting the details of this upcoming film, particularly the genre and the powerful role Balayya is expected to play.

## Jaat 2 Development

Meanwhile, Gopichand confirmed that the script work for Jaat 2 is already underway. The director and his team are taking audience feedback into account as they plan the sequel, aiming for an even bigger impact than the first film.

## Schedule and What’s Next

With two major projects in the works, one in Tollywood and another in Bollywood, Gopichand Malineni’s schedule is packed until the end of 2026. Fans can expect exciting updates on his ventures with Balakrishna and Jaat 2 soon.
